Senses.Explanation: The frog at the bottom of a well performs impossible actions: Baima Ai makes it swallow the moon, while Xueguan Zhiyin makes it fly into the sky. Later masters raise and verse the image as a deliberately cramped scene whose action exceeds its setting. Complete-unit reading distinguishes original utterance, later raising, verse/commentary, biography, and paratext, and controls duplicate recensions at the deployment-family level.
